title: Universal Brain 3D v2.2 & InkBlitz 3D: Closed-Loop Asynchronous Functionalist Whole-Brain Cognitive Architecture for Partially Observable 3D Environments
description:
Universal Brain 3D (v2.2) is a domain-agnostic, 60 Hz closed-loop functionalist cognitive architecture designed for partially observable, dynamic 3D environments, accompanied by the standalone InkBlitz 3D symmetric paint-territory and core-escort tactical arena.

Key components include: (1) an asynchronous 7-process lock-free SeqLock+CRC32 bus enforcing strict single-GPU isolation (Barrier 1); (2) a 4-layer allocentric cognitive field map with stationary-landmark EKF-SLAM and mid-episode respawn re-anchoring; (3) decoupled 6-DoF locomotion vs. cerebellar 3D ballistic lead-aim and basal ganglia STN-SNr timing control; (4) a 3-head multi-step categorical RSSM world model with counterfactual exposure de-confounding and live UBWM visual verification; (5) metastable Global Neuronal Workspace ignition with bidirectional top-down perceptual/hippocampal feedback; (6) Oizumi et al. (2016) lagged causal integrated information (Phi_G); (7) Plan-A motor-isolated grounded inner speech; and (8) single-GPU Population-Based Training (PBT) self-play with 4-stage offline sleep consolidation (S-1..S-4).
access_conditions: Research preview archive establishing architectural priority. Access to source and executable bundles may be requested for academic and non-commercial research evaluation under GPL-3.0.
notes: Developed by Alpha496 (Independent Researcher). Includes deterministic 7-stage headless self-verification suite (--mode verify_all) requiring only Python, NumPy, and PyTorch, plus optional Unity 6 binary wire integration (InkBlitz 3D).
